parsed.explanation: The write-up states the key divisibility equivalence but expressly omits its proof. No other passage supplies an all-cases argument, including zero or equal valuations and the unchanged coordinates. A sentence can repair it: assuming α≤β, a positive t divides α and β iff it divides α and β−α; this remains valid when α=0 or α=β, and taking the gcd together with all unchanged valuations proves invariance of the full tuple.
